newsitem.title: FINLAND: MERITA ANALYST SAYS NOKIA VIEW UNCHANGED.
newsitem.headline: MERITA ANALYST SAYS NOKIA VIEW UNCHANGED.

text.p: Merita telecoms analyst Martti Larjo said on Friday he had not altered his recommendations or forecasts for telecommunications group Nokia Oy after the company's presentation to analysts on Wednesday.
"I don't think anyone following Nokia closely will have changed their views," he told Reuters.
He declined to reveal his stance on the stock or his estimates for the company's earnigns.
"The general picture was positive in the sense that there was nothing negative," he said.

On the positive side, he said he would increase growth rates in his long-term models for mobile phone markets since it seemed that once penetration is above 15 percent, it accelerates and does not stop at 30 percent.
"It could even rise as high as 100 percent in current high penetration areas," he said.
Many users will have several phones, for instance one in the car, one as a carry-on voice phone and a third for mobile data transfer, he predicted.
